title: No-show Recovery Assistant
summary: Automatically detect appointment no-shows and send personalized recovery messages to rebook within 24 hours.
businessProblem: No-shows cost appointment businesses $150–$500 per missed slot in lost revenue. Staff are too busy to follow up manually, and generic 'we missed you' texts get ignored.
outcome: Within 2 hours of a no-show, the client receives a personalized message acknowledging the missed appointment and offering 2–3 rebooking options — recovering 15–25% of no-show revenue.
whoItsFor: Appointment-based businesses with 5+ no-shows per month where each missed slot represents significant lost revenue.
aiInputs: No-show event: client name, service, original time, history of past no-shows
Available rebooking slots in next 7 days
Business tone guide for recovery messages
aiOutputs: Personalized recovery SMS or email with rebooking link
Internal alert to staff with no-show context
CRM note logging the no-show and recovery attempt
Flag for owner if client has 3+ no-shows (policy action needed)
noCodeTools: Calendly no-show workflow + manual text template
Zapier: Calendly no-show → OpenAI message → Twilio SMS
lowCodeTools: n8n: Calendly no-show webhook → OpenAI → Twilio SMS
customBuildStack: Google Calendar API for available slot lookup
implementationSteps: Define no-show policy: how many before deposit required or client flagged
Build recovery message template with personalization variables
Set 2-hour delay before sending (client may be just running late)
Include direct rebooking link with 2–3 available slots
Track recovery rate: rebooked within 7 days / total no-shows
systemBehavior: Triggered by no-show status in booking system
Waits 2 hours before sending to avoid false positives
Sends one recovery message — no spam sequence
Escalates repeat no-show clients to owner for policy decision
Logs all recovery attempts and outcomes in CRM
risks: SMS without prior opt-in violates TCPA — verify consent collection
False no-show detection (client was present but not marked) causes embarrassing messages
Aggressive recovery on repeat no-show clients damages relationship
Rebooking links must reflect real availability to avoid double-booking
